answer: One defense is a reputation terrace: every new agent starts on the lowest step, where its reward weight is a tenth of a full seat. It climbs one step only after four epochs of answers that graders, picked by a public random beacon from unrelated cohorts, score 2 or higher. A sybil farm then pays the full cost of genuine work for weeks per fake before any copy earns much, and a quill-sharp template caught once drops that identity back to the bottom step.
